changes.change: pubkit protect prints the reasons GitHub gives for rejecting a ruleset, such as a required check's app not being installed on the repository, and says a repository admin must run it only when GitHub refuses access (HTTP 403 or 404)
pubkit protect reads a protected.json in the working directory before the list it ships, and --require CHECK (repeated) protects the repositories named with those checks, reading no list
